task: Classify canonical instance-context paths in the existing risk subsystem map so Development Guard can resolve the declared tenancy authority.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This is a Control Plane classification repair only. It changes no runtime tenant resolution, but incorrect scope mapping can hide relevant high-risk guards or create false-green development evidence.

acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/instances/** is classified by the existing release-risk subsystem map instead of appearing as unresolved scope.
The mapping uses the existing auth-access-authority risk subsystem and does not change DOMAIN-TENANCY truth ownership.
Existing release-risk policy semantics outside this one path addition remain unchanged.
invariants: Development subsystem classification is risk/guard routing metadata, not domain truth ownership.
DOMAIN-TENANCY remains canonically owned by tenant-context-authority in domain-foundations.v1.json.
No runtime source file is modified in this transaction.

failureModes: Canonical instance files remain unresolved and block legitimate tenancy work.
The path is mapped to a low-risk or unrelated subsystem and relevant security guards are omitted.
The change accidentally alters unrelated release-risk patterns.
edgeCases: New files created under src/lib/instances/** inherit the same risk classification automatically.
Tests remain neutral and do not inflate the subsystem scope.

alternatives.summary: Leave canonical instance paths unresolved and work around the gate per feature.
alternatives.reason: The gate has no valid bypass for unresolved scope and repeated local workarounds would preserve a false Control Plane model.

alternatives.summary: Create a new release-risk subsystem named tenant-context-authority.
alternatives.reason: That would expand policy and knowledge applicability broadly when the existing high-risk auth/access guard family already covers privileged context resolution risk.

alternatives.summary: Add src/lib/instances/** to the existing auth-access-authority risk subsystem patterns.
alternatives.reason: It closes the specific unresolved risk-routing gap while domain-foundations continues to own the separate DOMAIN-TENANCY truth boundary.

specialistReviews.finding: Risk subsystem labels must not be treated as canonical domain owners.
specialistReviews.resolution: Only release-risk-policy changes; domain-foundations remains untouched and continues to declare tenant-context-authority.

specialistReviews.finding: A missing mapping can omit applicable Known Failures and produce false-green development scope.
specialistReviews.resolution: A deterministic regression test asserts the canonical instances glob is present in the high-risk mapping.

challenge.scenario: A future file is added under src/lib/instances without an explicit one-off mapping.
challenge.finding: The Control Plane could again report unresolved scope.
challenge.resolution: Use the directory glob src/lib/instances/** so future canonical files inherit classification.

challenge.scenario: The mapping is added under a medium/low-risk presentation subsystem.
challenge.finding: Privileged context changes could receive weaker replay and release treatment.
challenge.resolution: Map to the existing high-risk auth-access-authority operational subsystem.

challenge.scenario: The risk mapping is interpreted as moving tenant truth into DOMAIN-IDENTITY.
challenge.finding: Operational scope metadata could be confused with architecture ownership.
challenge.resolution: Keep domain-foundations unchanged and test that DOMAIN-TENANCY still owns src/lib/instances/**.

proofPlan: Add a deterministic regression test for the risk mapping and unchanged DOMAIN-TENANCY canonical ownership.
Run the normal Control Plane gates, Quality Tests, TypeScript and Production Build as required by CI.
Require exact-head Completion Truth and lifecycle closure.

requirements.requirement: Canonical src/lib/instances/** tenancy files are deterministically classified for Development Guard risk routing without changing DOMAIN-TENANCY ownership.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: DOMAIN-TENANCY canonical ownership of src/lib/instances/** remains unchanged.
No unrelated release-risk subsystem pattern is modified.

notes: Prerequisite isolation transaction required by Release Risk Budget before the high-risk tenant authority implementation. No runtime behavior changes.
